record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Classify the possible smoothness properties of hyperboloidal initial data at conformal infinity, and identify the weakest such conditions under which a positivity proof for the Bondi mass can be completed.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider an asymptotically hyperboloidal initial data set $(M,g,K)$ for the vacuum Einstein equations, where $M$ is a 3-manifold with a conformal boundary at infinity $\mathscr{I}$, $g$ is a Riemannian metric on $M$, and $K$ is a symmetric 2-tensor representing the second fundamental form. Suppose $M$ admits a conformal compactification: there exists a defining function $\Omega$ for $\mathscr{I}$ such that the rescaled metric $\tilde g=\Omega^{2}g$ extends to the boundary with some prescribed regularity (e.g. $C^{k}$ up to the boundary, $C^{\infty}$, or polyhomogeneous with controlled logarithmic terms).

The Trautman–Bondi mass $m_{\mathrm{TB}}$ of such a data set is defined as a boundary integral at $\mathscr{I}$ involving the conformally rescaled geometry.

Problem: Classify the possible smoothness/regularity behaviors of hyperboloidal initial data at conformal infinity $\mathscr{I}$ (e.g. finite differentiability up to the boundary, full smoothness, polyhomogeneous expansions, possibly with logarithmic terms), and determine the weakest such regularity condition at $\mathscr{I}$ under which a proof of the positivity of the Trautman–Bondi mass, namely $m_{\mathrm{TB}}\ge 0$ with equality only for Minkowski space, can be carried out for data satisfying the vacuum (or dominant-energy) constraint equations.
artifact.status_search_result: Positivity of the Trautman–Bondi mass has been established under several regularity assumptions at conformal infinity (e.g. polyhomogeneous and $C^1$-up-to-boundary conformal rescalings, and in higher dimensions). Recent work (2025) identifies conditions under which hyperboloidal data are free of logarithmic singularities, and the Bondi mass acts as a selector for such data. However, a complete classification of admissible regularity classes and identification of the optimal (weakest) hypotheses ensuring positivity remains an active area of investigation, so the problem is partially solved rather than fully closed.

status_evidence.title: The Trautman-Bondi mass of hyperboloidal initial data sets
status_evidence.snippet: Definition and positivity proof for the Trautman-Bondi mass under polyhomogeneous/C^1 conformal regularity.
status_evidence.claim: Positivity proven under specific regularity hypotheses, but not shown optimal.

status_evidence.title: Hyperboloidal initial data without logarithmic singularities
status_evidence.snippet: Existence of well-defined Bondi mass and angular momentum implies that generic solutions of the constraint equations are free of logarithmic singularities.
status_evidence.claim: Recent (2025) work refining regularity at conformal infinity relevant to Bondi mass.

status_evidence.title: Bondi Mass Cannot Become Negative in Higher Dimensions
status_evidence.snippet: Positivity established in higher dimensions under suitable conditions.
status_evidence.claim: Positivity proofs exist in restricted regularity settings.
